description: Asks Google AI Mode a question and returns the generated answer as markdown text plus up to 20 references (title, url, source). Use it for a summarized answer with its cited sources. Reference urls can be Google redirect links rather than publisher URLs. It does not return a ranked list of results (use google_search). Required: query.

country.description: Two-letter country code that localizes the answer and its sources, e.g. "it" or "gb". Omit for the source default, us.

language.description: Two-letter language code for the answer, e.g. "en" or "it". Omit for the source default, en.

query.description: Question in natural language, 1-8000 characters, e.g. "How does an espresso machine build pressure?".

name: google_ai_answer
title: Google AI Answer
